label: View
help: The card is the shareable event summary. The month grid is the sheet you print and pin up - picking it sets the export size to A4 landscape.

label: Month
help: Which month to draw, as YYYY-MM. Leave blank to use the month of the earliest date you have entered. There is no clock here, so with no month and no dates the grid asks you for one rather than guessing.

label: Week numbers
help: Add an ISO-8601 week number column. ISO weeks are Monday based, so on a Sunday-start grid each row shows the week of the Monday inside it.

label: Event name
help: Shows as the calendar entry's title (SUMMARY).

label: Starts
help: Local start date and time. Leave blank to default to today.

label: Ends
help: Optional. Leave blank for a 1-hour event.

label: All-day event
help: Ignore the time of day and book the whole date.

label: Location
placeholder: e.g. Nuremberg, or a meeting link
help: Where it happens. A place, or a link to join.

label: Description
help: Notes that ride along in the calendar entry.

label: Event URL
help: Optional link attached to the event.

label: Reminder
help: Add a pop-up alarm before the event starts.

label: More dates
help: Extra entries. They fill the month grid, and each one with a date and a title also rides along in the .ics as its own calendar entry. A row missing either is counted under the grid, never dropped in silence.
